intro: Korran has a message for Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar. You are to carry word back that Moktar is serving well out in Thousand Needles, and that Korran's studies are moving along.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Head back to Belgrom in Orgrimmar and tell him Moktar be doing his bidding well out in the Thousand Needles. Tell him also, that me studies progress, and I hope to be havin' learned more soon. That should please him greatly.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm appreciative of your efforts, adventurer. The warchief will enjoy hearing how tenacious you have been in your duties.
Oh, of course I will mention your name to him. He speaks to me often and values my opinions greatly.
Go now, I have much to do. And if you speak to Korran soon, and he has news of these creatures, then return to me--I would think they are a threat that must be taken seriously.
